svg.title: EnzyMind Workspace — from a question to figures and data
svg.desc: Four-step operation guide: describe your question, follow the analysis, inspect and download plots and tables, then reuse results in a follow-up. Screenshots show the Q0ZPV7 sequence, a platform-supplied AlphaFold structure and EasIFA site prediction, plus highlighted Python code and its sequence composition outputs.
